about.title: Electronics, then software.
about.subtitle: The degree is in electronics. The work since then is mobile architecture, Python services, and the path from a device to a release.
about.bioP1: Hello! I'm Eugenio Tesio, a Mobile Expert, Systems Architect, and Electronics Engineer with more than 14 years of end-to-end software delivery and hardware systems engineering.
about.bioP2: Most recently at ueno bank (ITTI S.A.E.C.A.) through Nov. 2026, I led mobile architecture for 50+ Flutter engineers, migrating legacy monoliths into an independent Micro-App & App Shell ecosystem, harmonizing BLoC and Riverpod across unified retail and corporate banking products, orchestrating 15-day automated release trains across 3 app stores, and enforcing Fintech RASP threat defense.
about.bioP3: Prior to ueno bank, I delivered mission-critical FastAPI Python backends with 100% test coverage and Flutter apps with golden UI tests at PairTree (adoption enablement platform), built cross-platform Riverpod apps and Nest.js / TypeScript microservices at Tandamos, and engineered high-throughput Spring Boot microservices on Google Cloud Platform at Valtech.
about.bioP4: Holding a formal Electrical & Electronics Engineering degree from Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (UTN), my engineering intuition extends from serial buses (RS485 Modbus) and EV charging protocols (OCPP 1.6) to cloud microservices and modern multi-agent AI workflows.
about.quote: I look for Python and Flutter work where architecture, test coverage, and the release train are what make the product reliable.

about.capstoneDesc: The capstone became Smart Lub, a telemetry device for Vulcano Lubricación. It reads industrial equipment over an RS485 bus, sends the packets over Ethernet or Wi-Fi, and stores the metrics for monitoring. The company commissioned it, and it shipped as a product.
about.capstoneNote: Commissioned by the company and became part of a commercialized product.
about.electronicsDesc: Understanding signal integrity, hardware interrupts, and serial communication creates a developer who writes remarkably robust, leak-free Flutter code and resilient distributed backend APIs.
